programmes.d: Gasquatch invites Blaze and AJ to his ice cream party! But he forgot something important – the ice cream! So, Blaze transforms into an Ice Cream Truck and races to reach Gasquatch’s house in time!

It’s time for the Gold Medal Games, and Blaze is ready to compete! But when Crusher cheats and sends his rival flying far away, Blaze has to speed back to Axle City to beat the buzzer and win that medal!
Blaze and AJ take off into space for a race that’s out of this world! Along the way to Planet Victory, they meet friendly aliens, dodge asteroids, and face off against Crusher’s space ship!
For the first time ever, Blaze and AJ are racing under the ocean! Blaze transforms into a submarine and speeds through sunken ships and coral reefs to reach the giant sand castle at the finish line!

When Axle City is visited by a littering raccoon, it’s up to Blaze to save the day as a Super Recycling Truck! He cleans up the town and rescues his friends – just in time for a final showdown with the Litter Critter!
Blaze stops into Gabby’s Garage for a quick repair – just as she gets an alert! Three far-flung trucks need her mechanical know-how! So, Blaze and AJ volunteer to help her take her garage on the go!

All of Axle City is enjoying the Balloon Fair – until Crusher and Pickle get stuck on a runaway hot-air balloon! Now it’s up to Blaze and AJ to rescue their high-flying friends… before they crash into the Slime Volcano!
Blaze and AJ are babysitting for Baby Gherkin! When it’s time for her nap, they tell her three epic bedtime stories about police, cowboys, and superheroes – all starring Blaze and his friends!

When a windstorm blows away the supplies for Stripes’ Animal Party, Blaze transforms into the one Monster Machine strong enough to haul it all back – a Big Rig! There’s nothing he can’t pull with that Big Rig Force!
Blaze and AJ make friends with a space alien named Gormy! But when Gormy’s jetpack loses power, they set out to help him find six special space batteries so he can fly home to his alien family!

Blaze and AJ are spending the day with some very special trucks: Blaze’s family! His Mom, Dad, and little sister Sparkle join Blaze in a race against Crusher to prove they’re the world’s fastest family!
Blaze and AJ are super excited to play their new video game. But when a video game wizard makes the game come alive, Blaze and AJ must level up and save Axle City from pixel pandemonium!
Officer Blaze just got his biggest case yet: tracking down the mischievous Treat Thief! With help from Officer Anna, Blaze sets out to stop the thief and recover every stolen treat!
In their biggest race ever, Blaze and AJ go head-to-head against Crusher to race all the way around the Earth and win the World’s Biggest Trophy!

Kalamazoo/Save the Cow Who Jumped Over the Moon!: Ming-Ming visits her Aunt Eleanora at the local petting zoo during a school holiday. Eleanora asks Ming-Ming to take care of her toddler cousin, Marvin, for the afternoon.

The Wonder Pets get a call from a baby armadillo who is afraid his Old West-style town is haunted! The Wonder Pets journey into a watercolor painting to save the Itsy Bitsy Spider who keeps getting washed away.

The Wonder Pets play hide and seek with a gecko in Costa Rica and return to the classroom to find that the precocious gecko! The Wonder Pets get a call from an animal in distress but their phone is broken!

The Wonder Pets travel to Linny's grandmother's local nursing home to rescue an old white mouse who's stuck in a cuckoo clock. Little Bee and Slug accidentally take the Flyboat for a ride that quickly gets out of control.

Save the Griffin!/Save the Rooster!: The Wonder Pets must become brave knights to rescue a baby griffin in medieval England whose tail is stuck beneath a stone. The Wonder Pets travel to a farm to help a young rooster wake the farm before sunrise.

The Wonder Pets travel to Las Vegas to assist three performing rats who are having trouble working together on their song and dance routine. The Wonder Pets journey to a small village in old Russia to save a fiddler crab.
The Wonder Pets travel to Memphis to save a baby hound dog in a mansion who is stuck inside a jukebox. The Wonder Pets help a Little glowworm discover what she's good at: Glowing!
Ollie invites the Wonder Pets to his warren for a sleepover. Tuck wakes up in the middle of the night and finds a visitor in the classroom—an extraterrestrial!

It's summer vacation, and the Wonder Pets rescue a young circus lion named Cubby from falling off a circus train. The penguin ringmaster is so impressed with the Wonder Pets that he offers them jobs at the circus!

The Wonder Pets get a call from a Cool Cat and Hip Hippo who are performing at a jazz club in Greenwich Village. The Cat wants to scat but the Hippo wants to bebop at the same time! Tuck's older cousin Buck comes to the classroom for a visit.

Ollie the Bunny tells the Wonder Pets that a magician put him in a hat and made him disappear! The Wonder Pets get a call from an unhappy Baby Monster who is throwing a tantrum and knocking over buildings in her toy city!

Ming-Ming decides to explore the classroom in search of action, adventure, and drama. She enters a diorama and finds a pair of beautiful ballet slippers/The Wonder Pets get a call from a Baby Dalmation in a fire station.
To celebrate their hundredth save, Linny presents Ming-Ming and Tuck with a special home movie.
As the Wonder Pets are on their way to rescue a Raccoon stuck in a recycling bin, the Flyboat breaks down! The Wonder Pets must use recycled materials to save the day!

The Wonder Pets get a call from Humpty Dumpty who is teetering precariously on a wall in a pop-up book. The team must show a colony of Meerkats the joys of voting when they can't agree on how to handle an approaching Jackal.

The Wonder Pets journey to Happyland Forest to help two cartoon bears learn how to share. The Wonder Pets get a call from a smelly Little Stinkbug! The team must show the Baby Stinkbug the joys of taking a bubble bath.

The Wonder Pets fly into a clay diorama to help a Young Mermaid who wants to be a Pirate. The Wonder Pets must help a Young Pony in the Old West make her first delivery as part of the famous Pony Express!

The Wonder Pets travel to Transylvania to help a Baby Bat who is afraid of the dark. The Wonder Pets head to the Old Globe Theatre to help a Young Shakespearian-actor Donkey who is not prepared for his performance.
In this film noir episode, narrated by Linny, the Wonder Pets must help a Fox whose diamond-studded collar has mysteriously disappeared.

When Aunt Eleanora asks Ming-Ming to watch little Marvin, Ming-Ming brings the whole team to KalamaZoo! When Bee and Slug decide to explore what life is like underground, they get stuck in some ooey gooey mud.

Ming-Ming flies through the shrink machine the wrong way and becomes enormous! In this swinging Andrews Sisters-style show, the Wonder Pets get a phone call from Little Bo Peep, who's lost her three singing Sheep.

The Wonder Pets travel to Cape Cod to help a Lobster in a lobster trap free himself before the trap is raised. Floppy the Elephant comes to the classroom for a sleepover. But when Floppy gets homesick, the team must help him feel at home.

The Wonder Pets travel to the Florida Everglades to reunite a pair of quarreling Lovebugs on Valentine's Day./The Wonder Pets get a call from Manchester, England where a Skunk Rocker can't find a band to play with him.

Ni Hao, Halloween: Trick or treat, it's Halloween! Kai-lan and her friends dress up to go trick or treating with Ye-Ye. Kai-lan is a dinosaur, Tolee's a panda, Hoho's the Monkey King, and Rintoo is his favorite – a dragon!
Beach Day: Kai-lan is excited because today she's going to the beach with Ye-Ye and her friends, to play in the sand, fly kites, and go in the water!

Roller Rintoo: Kai-lan and her friends are off to a roller rink to go skating! But when Rintoo won't put on his roller skates, Kai-lan thinks something is wrong. It turns out that Rintoo is scared of roller skating.

Rain or Shine: Kai-lan and her friends are planning a big day of playing outdoors, when suddenly it starts to rain! Kai-lan happily finds a way to play in the rain, but Rintoo, Tolee and Hoho are very upset because of the rain.
Ni Hao Kai-lan: Kai-lan and her friends wake up early today because...there's a CARNIVAL in the backyard with game booths, prizes and rides!

Lulu Day: Today, Kai-lan is having a playdate with her best girl friend, Lu-lu the rhino! Kai-lan is ready with all sorts of games and things to play with Lu-lu. But Lu-lu wants to play with DIFFERENT things than Kai-lan.
Sports Day: Kai-lan LOVES dinosaurs, and today she's made up a whole bunch of Olympic-style Dinosaur Games to play with her friends!

Kai-lan gets a phone call from her favorite great aunt , Gu-nai-nai, in China, inviting us to come to China and meet a baby panda! Ye-Ye, Kai-lan, and her friends take an airplane to China to meet the baby.

Kai-lan and her friends are hiking through the woods to the big Ladybug Festival! Tolee gets frustrated when the others don't listen to what he has to say. Kai-lan needs your help to figure out what to do.
Kai-lan, Rintoo and Stompy are making a special dinosaur-shaped balloon for Lulu's hot air balloon festival!
Everyone's going over to Tolee's boat house to play, and Kai-lan invites us, too! All the friends have a great time... until Rintoo accidentally rips Tolee's new panda painting.

Hoho is thrilled because he's finally old enough to stay awake for the Chinese Moon Festival. He gets disappointed when he can't see the moon in the cloudy sky and Kai-lan needs your help to figure out what to do.

Kai-lan and her friends are putting on a play based on the Chinese folktale about the Monkey King. When Rintoo gets the part that Hoho wanted, Hoho quits the play and it's up to the viewer to help Kai-lan figure out what to do.

Today, Kai-lan needs our help to plan a very special party for Ye-Ye to thank him for all he does for us. But when everything she plans goes wrong, Kai-lan gets very frustrated and starts to cry - much to the surprise of her friends!
